name: Generate titles for novels and books
description: Users asked for creative, promotional, or alternative book titles based on provided synopses, narratives, or themes, often requesting multiple options or specific stylistic variations. While the primary focus was on fiction and non-fiction books, some requests extended to generating book descriptions, subtitles, or alternative names for existing works.
